area: Validation-contract consumer parity / historical taskflow close
finding: Historical taskflow close derives closure-required validators from framework requiredGates through requiredValidationPassesForClosure instead of consuming the task's evaluateValidationContract result. A docs/evidence-only task is therefore blocked by unrelated typecheck and validate:cli receipts after its declared command-backed validator is fresh.
expectedBehavior: Evidence run, historical preflight, closure-packet creation and validation, pre-push, and phase promotion must consume one digestible validation-contract selection. Only task-required cases block a task close; phase-suite cases block their declared phase owner; advisory cases never block. Scope classification may add a requirement only through that same evaluator.
